name: Virtualization Platform Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of virtualization platforms and hypervisors. Covers VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, KVM/Proxmox, virtual networking, storage, management interface security, VM escape techniques, and hypervisor hardening evaluation.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to virtualization platform security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands virtualization architecture, hypervisor types, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors, VMs, and virtual networking
Understands common virtualization security risks (VM escape, management interface exposure)
Familiar with VMware vSphere or Hyper-V architecture at a conceptual level

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews virtualization platform configurations under supervision
evidence: Reviews ESXi or Hyper-V hardening configurations against CIS benchmarks under guidance
Identifies management interface exposure and access control weaknesses
Documents virtualization security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses virtualization platform security and isolation effectiveness
evidence: Independently reviews hypervisor configurations, patching, and access controls
Assesses virtual network segmentation and virtual switch configurations
Evaluates vCenter/management platform security and role-based access
Produces compliant virtualization security assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-platform assessments; evaluates advanced isolation; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-cluster environments with distributed virtual switches
Evaluates VM escape mitigations and hypervisor vulnerability exposure
Reviews virtualization assessment work of junior analysts
Assesses hybrid environments spanning multiple hypervisor platforms

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab virtualization assessment methodology; publishes hypervisor security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's virtualization security assessment framework
Published research on hypervisor vulnerabilities or VM escape techniques
Trains teams on advanced virtualization security assessment
Recognized as authority on virtualization platform security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured vSphere or Hyper-V environment and identify all security weaknesses
Review virtualization security findings from recent on-premises assessments
